invariants: The version-2 route exists only behind the explicit development pilot flag; ordinary Show reads, patches, creation, and file import remain version 1 by default.
A version-1 flat or composition Show converts explicitly to one validated version-2 record; a stored version-2 record cold-opens without passing through a version-1 normalizer.

Transition edits publish one complete candidate through the existing Show persistence queue and generic history policy; refusal, no-op, unsupported persistence, failed save, and superseded failure never leave partial state.
Version-aware D1 and provider writers replace the complete version-2 record and read back the same validated bytes while keeping version-2 rows out of ordinary version-1 reads.
Show-file export inventories every reachable ordinary or Group Pattern instance, custom Map, and transitive user Library; conflict remaps update all owners consistently before any import writes.

Migration inventory hashes and snapshots the source row before conversion, records source version and outcome per row, compare-and-swaps unchanged legacy rows, reopens the written record, resumes safely, and restores every source column from backup.
Preview and .epe qualification compile through the version-2 preparation boundary; .pxlshow and .epe proof reopens through their actual importers.
partitions: Version-1 flat, version-1 composition, already-version-2, invalid/unknown version, and missing dependency inputs.

Ordinary and Group-owned Pattern references; built-in/user Pattern, custom/stock Map, direct/transitive Library, matching identity, conflicting identity, and missing dependency.
Convertible, already-version-2, undecodable, concurrently changed, interrupted-after-write, repeated, and rollback migration rows.
sequences: Open a version-1 Show on the opt-in route, convert, edit its Transition, preview, save, Undo, Redo, reload provider bytes, export, and reopen both artifacts.
Reload the browser at the saved Show route after the ordinary version-1 list excludes its row; cold-open the stored version-2 record and repeat artifact qualification.

Inventory an undecodable row and a source changed after inventory; record independent refusals while leaving both source rows recoverable.
